name: core.stop
title: Stop Xray Core (converge to stopped)
summary: Converge-to-stopped: a Core that is already stopped returns success with stopped=false rather than CoreNotRunning, so an extension retry after a lost response cannot surface a fake failure. Closing the Native Messaging port is NOT a stop request -- the Connector outlives the port (ADR-0005).

expectedConfigHash.description: Refuse with Busy if a running or restarting Core belongs to a different config; prevents stale browser recovery from stopping another session.
